note: Finding: `Extraction.first_surface` and `Extraction.crops` give a refinement, a table S and volume tables with `Extraction.RawLimits` (value convergence on compact generic sets and the ordered smear limit), `Extraction.copy_down` gives persistence, and `Extraction.room` with `Extraction.no_wrap_hit` puts compact subsets of Conf_n eventually in NoHit. verdicts.summary: [L] proves less than [M] prints. [M] prints `\partial_{\boldsymbol l}f_{P(k),v}\longrightarrow \partial_{\boldsymbol l}S_n(v;\cdot) \quad\text{locally uniformly on }\Conf{n}`.
evidence: `RawLimits` (Extraction/Lipschitz.lean:156-160) and `VolumePoints` (Extraction/Limits.lean:64-66) give only value convergence on compact K ⊆ generic n, i.e. coordinates distinct on every axis (Space/Configurations.lean:66), a set smaller than Conf_n. Neither Extraction/ nor `Org.Arrives.serves` (Org/Input.lean:101-109) states any fderiv or iteratedFDeriv convergence of the volume tables, so ∂_l f_{P(k),v} → ∂_l S_n is missing. C^∞ holds only for the replacement T (`Cleaner.smooth`, Input.lean:94), as the claim says.

`RawLimits` (Extraction/Lipschitz.lean:156-160) has only `regular` (ContinuousOn on generic sets), `mesh`, `volume` and `integral`. Smoothness is the field `Cleaner.smooth` of the replacement table T (Org/Input.lean:90-109), carried over through `RawLimits.ready` (Lipschitz.lean:194-202). No file in YM/Extraction or YM/Org uses fderiv or iteratedFDeriv, so the convergence ∂_l f_{P(k),v} → ∂_l S_n is not stated.
